Now we have second step precursors: fragment A: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=O)cc2)cc1 (a sulfonyl aryl with aldehyde) and fragment B: O=C(O)CC(=O)O (malonic acid? actually succinic? It's O=C(O)CC(=O)O = malonic acid). Good.

Now third template 733 must be applied to one of these fragments (or maybe to fragment A). Need to check matching.

Check on fragment A.
